title: Closed support and geometric germ tests for module-sheaf sections
statement: Let Lambda be a commutative ring and F a sheaf of Lambda-modules on the small etale site of a scheme X [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. For an etale V over X and s in F(V), there is a closed subset T of V such that for every separably closed field Omega and v:Spec(Omega)->V, v(default) belongs to T exactly when the geometric germ of s at v is nonzero [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Its underlying set is exactly the algebraically closed geometric support used in [def-cbc-etale-section-proper-support]. Consequently SectionHasProperSupport is equivalent to the same support criterion using all separably closed points, together with properness of the reduced closed support over the base. Forgetting the scalar action detects zero germs.

proof.text: Forget the scalar action. Filtered-colimit preservation gives the geometric-fibre comparison with the underlying abelian sheaf, and that isomorphism detects zero.

Apply [lem-sc-etale-section-zero-open] to the underlying abelian sheaf and take the closed complement of its open zero locus. The germ criterion of that theorem gives the criterion at every separably closed point. Algebraic closures of residue fields provide such points over every scheme point, giving the asserted underlying support set and equality of the two proper-support tests.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleModuleSection_closedSupport
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (V : X.Etale)
    (s : F.obj.obj (op V)) :
    ∃ T : TopologicalSpace.Closeds V.left,
      (∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (v : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ V.left),
        v default ∈ T ↔
          (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (v ≫ V.hom)).toPresheafFiber V
            (Over.homMk v) F.obj s ≠ 0) ∧
      (T : Set V.left) =
        {x | ∃ (Ω : Type u) (_ : Field Ω) (_ : IsAlgClosed Ω)
          (v : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ V.left), v default = x ∧
            (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (v ≫ V.hom)).toPresheafFiber V
              (Over.homMk v) F.obj s ≠ 0}
